land_pattern.package: ABS / ABF, body D 4.9-5.2 x E 4.2-4.5 mm, lead span HE 6.0-6.4 mm, lead pitch d 3.8-4.2 mm, lead width e 0.5-0.7 mm
land_pattern.notes: Pulled land ABF_L5.1-W4.4-P4.00-LS6.2-BL matches the datasheet body/span/pitch on all four dimensions. Its pads run 1.97-3.67 mm from centre, which covers the 0.6 mm foot with ~0.5 mm of heel and ~0.5 mm of toe - more generous than the vendor's own 2.0 x 1.0 mm recommendation, whose toe is 0.1 mm short at maximum lead span.
